title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: binding deadline, premium prepayment and credit hold
content:
## Scope

This policy of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line sets the three gates checked before a cover is bound: the binding deadline counted back from the scheduled departure, prepayment of premium by a cash-in-advance holder, and the bar on binding a CargoCare product while the holder is on credit hold. Each gate rests on the system records named below, read before the binding.

## Binding deadline

1. A cover must be bound no later than the tier's binding deadline, stated in calendar days before the scheduled departure date.
2. The clock starts from the scheduled departure date recorded on the booking the cover attaches to.
3. The binding deadline is that scheduled departure date minus the tier's deadline days, counted on calendar dates.
4. Binding on the deadline date itself is allowed; binding on any later date is not.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical dates and a hypothetical deadline of 3 days)

| Scheduled departure | Deadline date | Binding date | Judgement |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20 May | 17 May | 17 May | In time (the deadline date itself) |
| 20 May | 17 May | 16 May | In time |
| 20 May | 17 May | 18 May | Too late |
| 2 March 2026 | 27 February 2026 | 27 February 2026 | In time; the count runs across the month end on calendar dates |
| 2 March 2026 | 27 February 2026 | 28 February 2026 | Too late |

## Prepayment of premium

When the cover holder's credit status is cash in advance and the product requires prepayment, the premium must be received before binding. The evidence is the holder's credit status on the customer record and the premium payment entries on the cover's premium account.

| Holder's credit status | Product requires prepayment | This gate requires premium received before binding |
|---|---|---|
| Cash in advance | Yes | Yes |
| Cash in advance | No | No |
| Credit approved | Yes | No |
| Credit approved | No | No |

## Credit hold

A cover holder on credit hold cannot bind a CargoCare product. The holder's credit status is read from the customer record: a status of cash in advance or credit approved passes this gate, and a holder on credit hold does not bind a CargoCare product.

## Points of judgement

**The customer says the departure has slipped by two days. Which date counts?** The scheduled departure date recorded on the booking; the gate rests on the system record.
